title: Kamrupar Buranji (2nd Ed)
author: Dr. Suryya Kumar Bhuyan
description: Definitive second edition of Kamrupar Buranji published by the Department of Historical and Antiquarian Studies (DHAS), containing detailed accounts of medieval Assam's western frontiers, diplomatic letters, and treaties between the Tai Ahom court and Delhi.
